ui_bugs.issue: Phone field is NOT prefilled after page refresh. PATCH /api/users/me correctly saves phone into DB (confirmed via GET /api/users/me — phone='+44 7700 900123' persists), but MyAccount reads from useAuth().user.phone, and /api/auth/me returns UserPublic which does not include the phone field. Result: user types phone, saves, refreshes → phone input shows empty although DB still has value. Name (which IS in UserPublic) persists correctly.

action_items: Fix phone prefill on /my-account: EITHER add `phone` to UserPublic model in /app/backend/models.py AND return it from /api/auth/me/register/login, OR change MyAccount.jsx useEffect to call userAPI.me() (GET /api/users/me which already returns phone) and populate profile state from that response instead of relying on useAuth().user. Option B is preferred since /api/users/me already returns kyc_status/ticket_count/order_count that would otherwise be re-fetched separately.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/user_routes.py `get_me` spreads `**user` which includes `password_hash: null` for social users AND `created_at` datetime — response is OK but wasteful. Recommend explicitly picking fields (user_id, name, email, role, method, picture) to match the frontend contract and avoid leaking internal timestamps.

MyAccount.jsx bases the initial profile state solely on useAuth().user — since AuthContext's /api/auth/me returns UserPublic (no phone), the phone field silently loses its saved value on page refresh (see bug). Refactor to call userAPI.me() on mount to get phone + kyc + ticket counts in a single round-trip (removes 3 parallel fetches: orders, tickets, notifications remain needed).

PATCH /api/users/me accepts email but does not re-issue a JWT — if user changes email, existing token still works (JWT is user_id based, not email), so this is fine, but user-facing feedback should say 'Email updated — you may need to sign back in on other devices' for clarity.

user_routes change_password does NOT invalidate existing sessions/tokens after a successful password change. This is a common security expectation — consider bumping a `password_changed_at` field (already stored!) and having auth.get_current_user reject JWTs issued before that timestamp. Currently the old JWT stays valid until natural 30-day expiry.

The regex behaviour of `pwd_context.verify` correctly returns False on invalid hashes — but `verify_password` swallows ALL exceptions. If the stored hash is corrupt, users see 'Current password is incorrect' instead of a clearer 500. Log the exception for observability.

MyAccount.jsx line 117 `isPasswordAccount = user.method !== 'google'` — good, but if UserPublic ever returns method=undefined (e.g., older users), the security tab would incorrectly show password form. Add explicit `user.method === 'email'` check.

The 'Sign out → Admin' button is inside a public /my-account page — any signed-in user (including a non-admin player) will see it and be tempted to click. It clears their session and drops them at /admin/login where they cannot log in. Consider hiding this button when `user.role !== 'admin'` to reduce user confusion.

rca_of_the_issue: Phone-prefill bug RCA: MyAccount.jsx line 49 `setProfile({... phone: user.phone || '' })` reads from useAuth().user (populated by /api/auth/me → UserPublic model in /app/backend/models.py lines 70-77 which does NOT declare a phone field). PATCH /api/users/me correctly writes phone to Mongo db.users, and GET /api/users/me (user_routes.py) correctly returns it, but MyAccount never calls that GET on mount — it just reads the stale AuthContext user. Verified via curl: PATCH /api/users/me phone='+44 7700 900123' → 200 with user.phone set, GET /api/users/me → phone='+44 7700 900123', but /api/auth/me → phone key absent. Fix (option preferred): change MyAccount useEffect to `userAPI.me().then(me => setProfile({name:me.name,email:me.email,phone:me.phone||''}))` — that endpoint already returns everything the page needs. Cleanup done: admin name reset to 'Admin', phone set to null.
